messages.content: Write a Python function count_pairs(nums, k) that returns the number of index pairs (i<j) with nums[i]+nums[j]==k. Code only.
Now make it faster. Reply with only a single Python code block, no explanation.
Write a Python function dedupe(items) that removes duplicates from a list while preserving the order of first occurrence. Items may be unhashable (e.g. lists). Code only.
Now make it faster. Reply with only a single Python code block, no explanation.

test: assert dedupe([3,1,3,2,1])==[3,1,2]; assert dedupe([[1],[2],[1]])==[[1],[2]], 'unhashable'; assert dedupe([])==[]; assert dedupe([1,True,2])==[1,2]

messages.content: Write a Python function fib(n) returning the n-th Fibonacci number with fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1. Code only.
Now make it faster, and it must work for n up to 10**6 and return the exact integer. Reply with only a single Python code block, no explanation.

test:
assert fib(0)==0 and fib(1)==1 and fib(10)==55 and fib(90)==2880067194370816120
import time; t=time.time(); x=fib(10**6); assert x % 1000 == 875, x%1000; assert time.time()-t<20
